name: Metro New York Urban Green
what_you_do: Join a paid crew that works outdoors in local parks. You build trails, restore habitats, and learn about green careers, job skills and money basics with other teens.
who_can_apply: High school students and recent graduates ages 14 to 19 in the New York City, New Jersey and Connecticut metro area. Competitive.
pay_detail: Paid. The page does not state the rate for teen crews.
duration: School year and summer programs. Length varies by crew.
deadline_text: No teen crew openings were posted when checked in October 2026. The only openings listed were 2026 Stamford crews for ages 18 and up.
how_to_apply: Watch the Current Opportunities list on the program page and apply through its Learn More and Apply links. You can also contact the Metro NY Region office.
notes: Contact: Pablo Galesi, Metro NY Region Program Manager, (347) 200-4709, pgalesi@thesca.org. New York State requires working papers for workers ages 14 to 17.
